items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18

ctx.x: I played a couple of times with a couple of times with a drum. I played a drum. I played a drum.

And Dave, Dave, what do you mean? Dave, that's all I know used to play. And Chani, used to play with Chani. I had a job at the last roundup, used to play with Chani and Po Re. I played so many different places at the last roundup, yeah, we used to play there, me and Chani and he's living here, Chani. Yes. I never did get to meet him. I saw him on the street once, about a half a block away somebody pointed him out but I
never did get to talk to him. He used to play with the tuxedo. Yes, Celestan and that group I think. Celestan.
